mika (SRE): Proposal: pilot a short 'closure window' for postmortem actions. 10 business days, each action needs owner + due_date + three-phase status (triage -> fix -> verify). one weekly 30m sync until all actions closed.

Anya: sounds reasonable. can you show the tracker fields you want?

mika (SRE): Minimal only: id, owner, svc, bucket, priority (P0/P1/P2), due_date (YYYY-MM-DD), status, verify_link, rc_bucket (infra/config/deploy/third_party), recurrence_flag. owner + due_date required.

Raj: add a tiny risk flag (regression_yes/no) and a root-cause category for rollups. helps spot repeating patterns.

Anya: on rotation, monthly IC swaps cause lost context. propose 6-week IC slots with a 1-week overlap handoff so open actions don't fall through cracks.

mika (SRE): agree. ops-bot automation plan: DM owner reminders at 48h and 7d, label incidents with 'follow-through', mark action stale after 14d and auto-assign a review owner from rotation if stale.

ops-bot: automated: "Reminder: 2 open postmortem actions assigned to Raj >3 days. Run /pm-list to view."

Raj: verification needs to be light. require a 1-paragraph verification note + link to dashboard or smoke-test steps. otherwise people won't close things.

Anya: can the tracker surface recurrence? e.g., svc+bucket count>1 in 30d => flag for recurrence review. if flagged twice in 60d, schedule a deeper RCA.

mika (SRE): Good. Pilot plan: run on next two Sev1/Sev2 incidents that hit oncall (IDs: 5302, 5310). Anya will host pilot weekly syncs and capture metrics: median time-to-verify, stale_count, recurrence_flags.

Anya: i'll run it, start next Tuesday. please DM me if you're assigned an action in the pilot so I can include you in the sync.

mika (SRE): i'll draft a one-pager + tracker CSV and post in #eng-oncall by EOD. if pilot succeeds, we'll add a small repo with the template and ops-bot scripts and recommend the IC overlap change.

ops-bot: automated: "Label follow-through-pilot added to incidents 5302, 5310."
